# VR Plus Construction

VR Plus Construction is a residential and commercial construction company serving Vancouver and Metro Vancouver, British Columbia.

## Contact
- Phone: (778) 318-6796
- Email: admin@vrplusconstruction.com
- Primary office: 636 Clyde Ave, West Vancouver, BC

## Core services
- [Custom Homes](https://vrplusconstruction.com/custom-homes-vancouver-bc/): Design-led custom homes, managed from early planning through final finishes.
- [Renovations](https://vrplusconstruction.com/remodeling-and-renovation/): Whole-home, kitchen, bathroom and basement renovations with disciplined coordination.
- [Commercial](https://vrplusconstruction.com/commercial-construction/): Commercial construction and tenant improvements shaped around operations and schedule.
- [Condo Renovation](https://vrplusconstruction.com/condo-renovation-vancouver/): Thoughtful condo upgrades coordinated with strata and building requirements.
- [Luxury Renovation](https://vrplusconstruction.com/luxury-renovation/): Refined interior transformations with custom details and carefully managed finishes.
- [Multiplex](https://vrplusconstruction.com/multiplex-construction/): Purposeful multi-unit housing planned for livability, approvals and efficient delivery.
- [Design + Engineering](https://vrplusconstruction.com/design-and-civil-engineering/): Coordinated design and engineering support that keeps buildability in view.
- [Pre-Construction](https://vrplusconstruction.com/pre-construction/): Early planning that connects scope, design, budget, permits and schedule.
- [Construction Management](https://vrplusconstruction.com/construction-management/): Organized oversight for people, information, schedule, quality and closeout.
- [Energy-Efficient Homes](https://vrplusconstruction.com/energy-efficient-home/): Comfort-focused envelope and system upgrades for lower energy demand.
- [Green Building](https://vrplusconstruction.com/green-building-contractor/): Practical material and performance choices for more responsible construction.
- [Seismic Retrofit](https://vrplusconstruction.com/seismic-retrofit-plan-single-family/): Retrofit coordination for existing homes with qualified structural professionals.

## Service areas
Vancouver, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Richmond, Surrey, Delta.
